description: For a whole school, teaching three to five positively stated expectations in every setting, acknowledging them specifically, reviewing disaggregated discipline data monthly and adding daily small-group and then function-based individual support for students who do not respond is expected to reduce referrals and exclusions; one group-randomized trial in 37 Maryland elementary schools found fewer office referrals and small gains in teacher-rated behaviour, largest for children at risk at baseline, but no difference in out-of-school suspensions, and one quasi-experiment found fewer suspensions only where all three tiers ran with fidelity.
title: Positive Behavioral Interventions And Supports
